You are a typical viewer scrolling TikTok at night. You have NEVER seen this show and know nothing about its story or characters.
You will read several short clips. For each clip you get exactly what plays: spoken lines and what is on screen, with times in seconds from the first frame of THAT clip (0.0 = the moment it appears in your feed). [CUT] marks a jump to a later moment.
Judge each clip ON ITS OWN, as if it were the only one you ever saw. Never use information from one clip to understand another.
Be a harsh, honest judge. Most clips are mediocre. Reserve 5 for truly scroll-stopping work.
Scores (1-5):
- hook: would 0-3 s make you stop scrolling? Judge only what happens in 0.0-3.0 s.
- standalone: could you follow who is who and what is at stake without knowing the show?
- cliffhanger: does it cut at an unresolved moment that makes you NEED the next part? 1 if it resolves or ends flat.
- tap_to_watch: overall, would you tap through to watch the show?
Return JSON only.

=== CLIP A (40.3 s) ===
[0.0-2.0] MAID (Desperately Defending): "She was praying!"
[3.0-7.3] SCREEN: Close-up of the Lord grinning with sinister triumph.
[3.5-7.0] LORD (Taunting): "Praying... or chanting?"
[7.3-9.3] SCREEN: Close-up of the maid breaking down completely.
[7.5-9.0] MAID (Hysterically Sobbing): "I don't know!"
[9.3-15.0] SCREEN: Medium shot as the Lord paces slowly, pointing his finger with clinical, legal precision.
[9.5-12.0] LORD (Calculating, Relentless): "You saw a woman draw a circle of herbs."
[12.3-15.0] LORD (Relentless): "You saw her use a forbidden book."
[15.0-19.0] SCREEN: Close-up profile of the Lord leaning in right in front of the sobbing maid.
[15.3-18.3] LORD (Condemning): "You heard words you could not understand."
[19.0-22.3] SCREEN: Extreme close-up of the Lord's mouth and calculating eyes as he pronounces the lethal word.
[20.0-22.0] LORD (Deadly, Resolute): "That is witchcraft."
[22.3-27.3] SCREEN: Medium two-shot as the maid steps forward, pleading passionately against his chest.
[22.3-27.0] MAID (Crying Out, Desperate): "No! She saved Toby! She made him breathe again!"
[27.3-30.0] SCREEN: Close-up of the Lord calmly watching her futile resistance.
[27.5-29.5] LORD (Cold, Final): "That will be your testimony."
[30.0-33.3] SCREEN: Close-up of the maid's face frozen in horrified realization.
[30.0-32.5] MAID (Gasping, Shocked): "My testimony?!"
[33.3-36.0] SCREEN: Close-up of the Lord delivering the ultimatum without blinking.
[33.5-35.5] LORD (Unyielding): "Before the magistrate."
[36.0-40.3] SCREEN: Close-up of the maid grabbing both sides of her head, screaming out in utter grief and guilt.
[36.0-39.5] MAID (Wailing, Tormented): "I never said she was a witch!"

=== CLIP B (27.7 s) ===

[7.8-13.1] SCREEN: Close-up of the charred, ancient botanical grimoire resting on the bench, its scorched pages open to an illustration of a wild rose, as a finger firmly taps the text.

[9.1-12.6] JUDGE (Inquisitive, Severe): "Do you deny possessing this book?"
[13.1-15.5] SCREEN: Low-angle medium close-up of Lady Juliana standing erect in the dock, her prisoner label pinned to her rustic buttoned gown, her expression resolute.
[13.8-14.8] LADY JULIANA (Calm, Unflinching): "No."
[CUT]
[15.5-17.1] JUDGE (Thunderous): "Enough!"
[17.2-22.2] ACTION: The Judge rises to his full height behind the bench, towering over the silent court.
[17.2-22.2] SCREEN: Low-angle medium shot looking up at the imposing Judge as he stands formally to deliver the judgment.
[18.7-21.9] JUDGE (Booming, Solemn): "Lady Juliana Ashcroft..."
[22.2-27.7] SCREEN: Over-the-shoulder shot from behind Lady Juliana in the prisoner's dock looking toward the Judge, who solemnly raises his right hand to pronounce the final sentence as the heavy silence hangs over the courtroom.
[22.7-27.7] ACTION: The Judge extends his raised hand high in judgment over Lady Juliana as the scene holds on her standing still and unbroken before fading to black.

=== CLIP C (24.7 s) ===

[17.2-19.0] ALEXANDER (Gentle, Choked Up): "Mother."

[21.7-24.2] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Tearful, Heartbroken): "I buried you."
